<!-- experiments-sdk -->
<script nitro-exclude>
  (function (window) {
    'use strict';

    const COOKIE_NAME = 'ab_assignments';
    let assignmentsCache = null;
    let urlParamsCache = null;

    function getCookie(name) {
      const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
      const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
      if (parts.length === 2) {
        return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
      }
      return null;
    }

    function setCookie(name, value, days) {
      const date = new Date();
      date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
      const expires = `expires=${date.toUTCString()}`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=${value};${expires};path=/`;
    }

    function getAssignments() {
      if (assignmentsCache !== null) {
        return assignmentsCache;
      }

      try {
        const cookieValue = getCookie(COOKIE_NAME);
        if (!cookieValue) {
          assignmentsCache = {};
          return assignmentsCache;
        }
        assignmentsCache = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(cookieValue));
        return assignmentsCache;
      } catch (e) {
        if (isDebugMode()) {
          console.warn('[AB Testing] Failed to parse assignments cookie:', e);
        }
        assignmentsCache = {};
        return assignmentsCache;
      }
    }

    function saveAssignments(assignments, persistenceDays) {
      try {
        const cookieValue = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(assignments));
        setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, cookieValue, persistenceDays || 30);
        assignmentsCache = assignments;
      } catch (e) {
        if (isDebugMode()) {
          console.warn('[AB Testing] Failed to save assignments cookie:', e);
        }
      }
    }

    function generateRandomRoll(experimentKey) {
      const assignments = getAssignments();

      if (assignments[experimentKey] !== undefined) {
        return assignments[experimentKey];
      }

      const roll = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100);
      assignments[experimentKey] = roll;

      const experiment = getExperiment(experimentKey);
      const persistenceDays = experiment && experiment.persistence_days ? experiment.persistence_days : 30;

      saveAssignments(assignments, persistenceDays);

      return roll;
    }

    function getExperiment(experimentKey) {
      try {
        if (!window.ABConfig) {
          return null;
        }

        if (window.ABConfig.experiments && window.ABConfig.experiments[experimentKey]) {
          return window.ABConfig.experiments[experimentKey];
        }

        if (window.ABConfig[experimentKey]) {
          return window.ABConfig[experimentKey];
        }

        return null;
      } catch (e) {
        if (isDebugMode()) {
          console.warn('[AB Testing] Error accessing ABConfig:', e);
        }
        return null;
      }
    }

    function matchesTargetPage(experiment) {
      if (!experiment || !experiment.target_pages) {
        return false;
      }

      const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
      const targetPages = Array.isArray(experiment.target_pages)
        ? experiment.target_pages
        : [experiment.target_pages];

      for (const target of targetPages) {
        if (target === '*') {
          return true;
        }

        if (target === currentPath) {
          return true;
        }

        if (target.startsWith('./')) {
          // Prefix match: "./product" matches "/product", "/product/123", etc.
          const prefix = target.substring(2);
          if (currentPath.startsWith('/' + prefix)) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      }

      return false;
    }

    function isWithinTimeWindow(experiment) {
      if (!experiment) {
        return false;
      }

      const now = new Date();

      if (experiment.start_date) {
        const startDate = new Date(experiment.start_date);
        if (now < startDate) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      if (experiment.end_date) {
        const endDate = new Date(experiment.end_date);
        if (now > endDate) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      return true;
    }

    function isExperimentActive(experiment) {
      if (!experiment) {
        return false;
      }

      if (experiment.status && experiment.status !== 'active') {
        return false;
      }

      if (!isWithinTimeWindow(experiment)) {
        return false;
      }

      if (!matchesTargetPage(experiment)) {
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    }

    function getVariantForRoll(experiment, roll) {
      if (!experiment || !experiment.variants) {
        return null;
      }

      let variants = [];

      if (Array.isArray(experiment.variants)) {
        variants = experiment.variants;
      } else if (typeof experiment.variants === 'object') {
        // Convert object format { "control": { weight: 50 }, "variant1": { weight: 50 } }
        variants = Object.keys(experiment.variants).map(name => ({
          name: name,
          weight: experiment.variants[name].weight || 0
        }));
      }

      if (variants.length === 0) {
        return null;
      }

      let cumulativeWeight = 0;
      for (const variant of variants) {
        cumulativeWeight += variant.weight || 0;
        if (roll < cumulativeWeight) {
          return variant.name;
        }
      }

      return variants[variants.length - 1].name;
    }

    function getUrlParam(name) {
      if (urlParamsCache === null) {
        urlParamsCache = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      }
      return urlParamsCache.get(name);
    }

    let debugModeCache = null;
    function isDebugMode() {
      if (debugModeCache === null) {
        const debugParam = getUrlParam('ab_debug');
        debugModeCache = debugParam === '1' || debugParam === 'true';
      }
      return debugModeCache;
    }

    // Format: ?ab_override=experimentKey:variantName
    function getOverride(experimentKey) {
      const override = getUrlParam('ab_override');
      if (!override) {
        return null;
      }

      const parts = override.split(':');
      if (parts.length !== 2) {
        return null;
      }

      const [key, variant] = parts;
      if (key === experimentKey) {
        return variant;
      }

      return null;
    }

    function checkExperimentFlag(experimentKey, variantName) {
      try {
        const override = getOverride(experimentKey);
        if (override !== null) {
          const matches = override === variantName;
          if (isDebugMode()) {
            console.log(`[AB Testing] Override active for ${experimentKey}: ${override}, checking ${variantName} = ${matches}`);
          }
          return matches;
        }

        const experiment = getExperiment(experimentKey);
        if (!experiment) {
          if (isDebugMode()) {
            console.log(`[AB Testing] Experiment "${experimentKey}" not found in ABConfig`);
          }
          return false;
        }

        if (!isExperimentActive(experiment)) {
          if (isDebugMode()) {
            console.log(`[AB Testing] Experiment "${experimentKey}" is not active`);
          }
          return false;
        }

        const roll = generateRandomRoll(experimentKey);
        const assignedVariant = getVariantForRoll(experiment, roll);

        if (!assignedVariant) {
          if (isDebugMode()) {
            console.warn(`[AB Testing] Could not determine variant for experiment "${experimentKey}"`);
          }
          return false;
        }

        const matches = assignedVariant === variantName;

        if (isDebugMode()) {
          console.log(`[AB Testing] Experiment: ${experimentKey}, Roll: ${roll}, Assigned: ${assignedVariant}, Checking: ${variantName}, Result: ${matches}`);
        }

        return matches;

      } catch (e) {
        if (isDebugMode()) {
          console.error('[AB Testing] Error in checkExperimentFlag:', e);
        }
        return false;
      }
    }

    window.checkExperimentFlag = checkExperimentFlag;

    if (isDebugMode()) {
      window.__ABTestingDebug = {
        getAssignments: getAssignments,
        getExperiment: getExperiment,
        isExperimentActive: isExperimentActive,
        matchesTargetPage: matchesTargetPage,
        isWithinTimeWindow: isWithinTimeWindow
      };
      console.log('[AB Testing] Debug mode enabled. Use window.__ABTestingDebug for debugging.');
    }

  })(window);
</script>
